title: ShareChat
bio: Indian social media app where users share posts and videos in Indian regional languages; the company also runs Moj.

title: Shiprocket
bio: Indian logistics platform that lets online sellers compare and book courier services, print labels and track shipments from one dashboard.

title: Simplilearn
bio: Online bootcamp and certification provider for digital and tech skills.

title: SiteGround
bio: Web hosting company offering shared, WordPress, WooCommerce and cloud hosting with domain registration and email services.

title: Skillshare
bio: Online learning community for creative and practical skills.

title: Skyscanner
bio: Travel search engine that compares prices for flights, hotels and car hire.

title: Snapdeal
bio: Snapdeal is an Indian online marketplace focused on value-priced fashion, home goods and everyday products from independent sellers.

title: SoundCloud
bio: Audio streaming platform where artists upload and share music and podcasts, and listeners stream tracks for free or by subscription.

title: Square Yards
bio: Square Yards is an Indian real estate platform offering property listings, brokerage, home loans and related services.

title: Squarespace
bio: Website builder and hosting platform with templates and online stores.

title: Starling Bank
bio: British digital bank offering personal, joint and business current accounts managed through a mobile app.

title: StockX
bio: StockX is an American online marketplace for reselling sneakers, streetwear, collectibles and electronics, with item verification before shipping.

title: Substack
bio: Platform that lets writers and creators publish newsletters, podcasts and video and charge readers for subscriptions.

title: SumUp
bio: SumUp provides card readers, point-of-sale software and payment tools that help small businesses accept card payments.

title: Supercell
bio: Finnish mobile game developer that makes Clash of Clans, Clash Royale, Brawl Stars and Hay Day.

title: Takealot
bio: Takealot is a South African online retailer and marketplace selling electronics, books, toys, appliances and household goods.

title: Tamara
bio: Tamara is a buy now, pay later provider in the Gulf region that lets shoppers split purchases into instalments.

title: Telegram
bio: Cloud-based messaging app with channels and large group chats.

title: Toptal
bio: Toptal is a talent network that connects companies with screened freelance software developers, designers, finance experts and project managers.

title: Toss
bio: Toss is a South Korean financial app offering money transfers, payments, banking, credit checks, investing and insurance services.

title: Trade Republic
bio: Trade Republic is a German broker and bank offering an app for investing in stocks, ETFs, bonds and savings plans.

title: Trading 212
bio: Online broker for stocks and ETFs with commission-free trading.

title: Traveloka
bio: Indonesian travel app for booking flights, hotels, trains, car rentals and activities across Southeast Asia.

title: Trezor
bio: Trezor makes hardware wallets and software for storing cryptocurrency private keys offline and managing digital assets.

title: Trustly
bio: Trustly provides open banking payments that let consumers pay merchants directly from their bank accounts without using cards.

title: Turo
bio: Peer-to-peer car rental marketplace where travelers book vehicles directly from local car owners.

title: Udacity
bio: American online learning company, owned by Accenture, offering project-based Nanodegree programmes in programming, data science and artificial intelligence.

title: Unacademy
bio: Indian online learning platform focused on exam preparation.

title: Upbit
bio: Upbit is a South Korean cryptocurrency exchange operated by Dunamu where users can buy, sell and trade digital assets.
